about: The phone's sealed messages as chatqd checks them (SPEC 2.8): keys per inbound label, b64url both ways, the confirmation code, and Open-ChatqSealed's check up to the MAC, on messages sealed by PowerShell and by docs/reply.html itself (tests/wire-vectors.js; input.page is the page's answer, which PowerShell's must equal) and on broken ones. An open answer is how far Unprotect-ChatqReplyMessage or Unprotect-ChatqComposeMessage got: stage format or mac is refused before the MAC checks out, decrypt or ok is past it, which is all chatqd decides; a decryption's "could not be read" text is cut to "could not be read: ...". The prefix is compared as -cne compares, linguistically, so a character the collation gives no weight to passes, and which those are differs by edition.
